# Quaternius — Ultimate Nature Pack, selected CC0 models

Author: [Quaternius](https://quaternius.com/).
Official pack and license statement: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatenature.html
License: **CC0-1.0**, commercial use and modification permitted; attribution is not
required, retained voluntarily. Legal code: CC0-1.0.txt.

Source bytes are GLB conversions from the third-party
[trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase](https://github.com/trebeljahr/quaternius-showcase)
mirror. Exact commit, Git tree, source paths and SHA-256 values are in manifest.json.
Each downloaded blob was checked against that pinned Git tree. Official license
page text/hash and the mirror's model-license table are retained. The showcase's
MIT code license is not used as the license for these models; no showcase code is
included.

Selected models: five pine silhouettes, two autumn birches, a bush and a moss rock.
Keep the source GLBs unmodified. Runtime metre normalization, material styling and
MultiMesh batching are project integration. Embedded textures require no downloads.

Manual vendoring/checks follow the user's authorized replacement for unavailable
game-dev tooling; this is not a game-dev canonical receipt. Verify all source
rosters with `python tools/verify_vendor_assets.py` from the repository root.
